question: After excluding decisions that did not consume the controlled curve baseline and decisions lacking either lane's complete frozen market-input schema, can every same-path executed-entry mismatch still be assigned by the frozen V10 attribution priority?

methodologyBoundary.reason: V10 correctly froze the effective baseline value but treated deterministic pre-guard cooldowns as baseline mismatches, dropped consumed baseline telemetry when the clone guard rejected, and left rows with incomplete actual buy-ratio telemetry marked comparable.

classifierEpoch.primaryCauseSelection: Inherit the frozen V10 cause priority after V11 comparability exclusions.
classifierEpoch.contributingCausePolicy: Record every detected contributing cause even when only one primary cause grades attribution.

baselineControl.selectedInvariant: For comparable selected-baseline rows, baselineControlConsumed and shadowBaselineAnchorHeldConstant are true and both anchor and curve-progress skew equal exactly zero.
baselineControl.unselectedInvariant: For a comparable valid frozen no-baseline control, baselineControlConsumed and shadowBaselineAnchorHeldConstant are true, baselineControlSelected is false, and both skew fields are null.
baselineControl.notConsumedTreatment: A deterministic branch that returns before evaluateEntryGuards remains visible but is scope-incomparable and cannot inflate gate agreement or fail the baseline invariant.
baselineControl.cloneGuardTreatment: A clone rejection occurs after the curve guard and must retain the consumed controlled-baseline telemetry even though the clone reason remains authoritative.
baselineControl.actualTelemetryAgreementRole: actualBaselineMatchesControl remains a separate telemetry-consistency diagnostic and is not substituted for the shadow control invariant.
baselineControl.historicalFieldAbsenceTreatment: Pre-V11 rows lacking baselineControlConsumed are historical fields-absent, never baseline mismatches.

nextIfPass: Keep Helius report-only and repeat under the unchanged V11 contract before proposing provider routing or strategy consumption.
nextIfFail: Fix only the demonstrated V11 instrumentation defect. Do not change strategy, freshness bounds, gates, exits, capacity, or provider routing.
